svg.text: Square 280 x 280; cut each corner square to the arm: 72 long face

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Corner faces lie 162 from the centre, measured along the diagonal

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Per corner four 4.3 holes for the hinge block: on the diagonal, 131 and 144 out, 15 either side

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four 3.3 holes for the spacers, 130 from the centre on the X and Y axes

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 30 hole at the centre for the pack leads and mast cable

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Over the Core lid: 26 hole at X -55 (mast boss), 12 holes at X 65 Y 32 either side and X 40 (SMA), 20 hole at X -15 Y 30 (switch)

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Route with a diamond or carbide cutter; wear a dust mask; seal the edges with thin epoxy

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: lies flat on the bottom plate with every hole in line
